lines.4: I strode straight toward the Princess.
lines.7: 「Yes, you told me that before. And then we ended things, remember? Did you lose your memory?」
lines.11: 「Agreed or not, a romance ends when one person's feelings cool off. Could you stop being so clingy?」
lines.12: 「You never said your feelings had cooled off.」
lines.13: 「You said I was getting in the way of your path to conquest.」
lines.14: 「What better reason could there be? If I have to choose between love and ambition, I choose ambition.」
lines.18: 「That you can have both. You're greedy, after all.」
lines.19: 「I decided to choose one because having both was becoming too difficult!」
lines.20: 「That's not the limit of what you can do. You can have both!」
lines.21: 「What kind of reasoning is that? You aren't seriously asking me to take you back because of it, are you?」
lines.23: I pushed the Princess halfway down beneath me.
lines.25: I had to go in ready to win the Princess over myself.
lines.26: A man could yield the rest of the time... even if he spent his whole life under her thumb...
lines.28: 「We're only getting started on all the memories we'll make together.」
lines.29: 「Why are you going berserk, you idiot?! Do you understand? I dumped you!」
lines.30: 「And following me around after that makes you a stalker, doesn't it?」
lines.31: 「Do you honestly think I'm a stalker?」
lines.32: 「No, but that's what it looks like to any normal person!」
lines.33: 「Wow. The Princess appealing to conventional wisdom.」
lines.36: 「I know that already! You've made it painfully clear!」
lines.37: 「I knew that when I dumped you. I did it for my ambition! Notice that we're talking in circles!」
lines.39: 「How are you going to conquer the world if you can't even keep one man?」
lines.40: 「...The problem is that you're not a man worth keeping!」
lines.41: 「I told you, didn't I? Compared with the elite men climbing the ladder whom I'm bound to meet, you're sure to lose your luster.」
lines.42: 「Sure, I'm not at that level now. I've been fooling around instead of studying.」
lines.43: 「But I don't think I have any less potential than they do. It's not too late for me. Give me any condition you want, and I'll meet it.」
lines.45: 「I'm serious. When someone is serious--especially someone like me--there isn't much he can't pull off.」
lines.46: 「At least your mouth is impressively arrogant.」
lines.47: 「Besides, there's one thing I know none of them can beat me at.」
lines.51: 「No one will ever beat me at that!」
lines.52: 「...Ugh. Why is this man getting so worked up?」
lines.53: 「Because you set my heart on fire.」
lines.55: 「I told you I don't hate you. If anything, I love you.」
lines.56: 「Ah... Ngh... I shouldn't have said that.」
lines.57: 「B-But we're back to being classmates! That's what I decided!」
lines.59: 「Aaargh! How did you get there?! Why do you think I slapped away the hand you offered me?」
lines.60: 「If you slapped my hand away, I just have to reach for it again.」
lines.61: 「That's called being persistent! It'll only make me hate you more.」
lines.62: 「I'd rather tell you everything I feel than regret keeping quiet. I'll say it as many times as it takes: I love you, Princess.」
lines.64: 「I know. But there are hopeless idiots and lovable idiots, and I think I'm the second kind.」
lines.65: 「You don't get to say that about yourself!」
lines.67: 「Show me the world you're going to conquer.」
lines.68: 「I'll be your knight and follow you anywhere.」
lines.69: 「That's the kind of person you're looking for, isn't it?」
lines.72: The Princess let out a long sigh.
lines.73: 「That was certainly a confession overflowing with momentum.」
lines.74: 「I could never say any of that in front of anyone but you.」
lines.75: 「And I probably won't be able to say it when I'm older, either.」
lines.77: 「I was lonely after we broke up, too.」
lines.79: 「I'd just been trying to get back into my old rhythm, and then you spring this on me.」
lines.81: 「Of course I don't! Not after that one-sided, cringe-inducing confession!」
lines.84: 「I can't conquer the world if I can't win one man? Hmph. You certainly know how to hit me where it hurts.」
lines.85: 「Fine, then I'll claim them both. Just you watch!」
lines.87: 「Hmph. Don't get carried away. If you're that madly in love with me, you'd better be ready to die as my shield.」
lines.88: 「As long as we're together, I'll be happy.」
lines.89: 「...Ugh. You really were a simple-minded fool all along.」
lines.91: 「What is all that noise? What now?」
lines.93: 「Huh...? I-It's ON?! I never switched it off... You mean the whole school heard all of that?! I let my guard down!」
lines.95: 「That concludes our rehearsal for the Ryuumei Festival play. Thank you.」
lines.101: 「Hahahaha! Leo and the Princess are the best! Right, Yohei, old buddy?」
lines.102: 「H-Hey, that hurts! Don't slap my back like we're close!」
lines.103: 「I was blushing just listening to it... Tsushima is really like that? I may have underestimated him.」
lines.104: 「That's right! Passionate, isn't he? That's my buddy!」
lines.105: 「Yes, that was a fine confession. Direct and full of feeling. That's my little brother.」
lines.106: 「Now, resume practice! Clear your minds of distractions!」
lines.108: 「I don't know why, but Kani-chi is freaking out and rampaging! Like, seriously!」
lines.109: 「Ah, to be young. That admirable honesty does my heart good.」
lines.110: 「Hee hee. Mr. Tsuchinaga, did you get a good recording?」
lines.111: 「You bet, Inori. I memorized every last word.」
lines.112: 「W-What in the world was that bizarre confession?」
lines.113: 「I not think so. It was romantic and wonderful.」
lines.114: 「Damn it! All that flirting makes me sick! I don't care if Leo flirts! I just hate being alone! I'm lonely!」
lines.115: 「Darn right! This whole world ain't fair!」
lines.116: 「...If he still has that much passion in him...」
